formula: orderContribution = settlementNet - notYetDeductedVariableCost; relativeContribution = orderContribution - displacedContribution
limitations: No platform alert threshold is assumed or estimated.
Displacement scenario assumes exactly one otherwise-completed alternative order is lost; not an empirical substitution rate.
No campaign causal effect, total shop net profit, or ROI is estimated.
Final settlement and costs must use one consistent tax, refund, fee and observation scope.
